title: Monkey
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M70 72 Q88 68 84 50 Q82 40 74 44' fill='none' stroke='#8a4f2a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='21' ry='24' fill='#a8632f'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='12' ry='16' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='68' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#8a4f2a' transform='rotate(15 27 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='68' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#8a4f2a' transform='rotate(-15 73 68)'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='81' r='6' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='81' r='6' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='90' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#8a4f2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='90' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#8a4f2a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='10' fill='#8a4f2a'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='5' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='10' fill='#8a4f2a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='5' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='27' fill='#a8632f'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='19' ry='17' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- brows -->
  <rect x='38' y='32' width='9' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#6b3a18'/>
  <rect x='53' y='32' width='9' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#6b3a18'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#3a2010'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#3a2010'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='38.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='38.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f7d29b'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='50' r='1.4' fill='#6b3a18'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='50' r='1.4' fill='#6b3a18'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 55 Q50 61 57 55' fill='none' stroke='#6b3a18' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
